name: Eye of the Vortex
text: Your Vortex gales pull everyone within 2, up to 2 hexes, toward the centre, when they fire and at the tick. Units stop at the first blocked hex (no slam). One of your Vortex gales acts per tick (the newest).

name: Wind Wall
text: Action, cooldown 3: raise a line of 3 wall hexes (empty hexes) starting within 3 of you, for 2 ticks. It blocks movement and skills both ways; basic attacks pierce it. One wall at a time.

name: Jetstream
text: Wind on a gale 2 makes a gale 3 (copies to radius 3). Your copies last 2 cycles and your Gust fields push 2. The field cap (2 hexes per cycle) still applies.

name: Skater
text: You never slide unless you choose to; on a slide line you choose where to stop. Ice hexes cost you 0 move for the first 4 each turn, then 1.

name: Flash Freeze
text: Once per battle, range 3, on a foe: it is Frozen. It skips its next turn, can't be displaced except by a slide, counts as standing on glaze, and its next hit taken is x2 (which thaws it). A boss doesn't skip its turn but still takes the x2.

name: Glacier Wall
text: Your pillars last all battle (still 4 at most) until melted or shattered. Target your own pillar with a basic or a skill to shatter it: 12% to all six neighbours, both teams, and a push of 1 away.

name: Prism
text: Your beams can bend once at a third ally on light, so a beam has up to 2 segments. Allies on your beams also heal 5% at the tick.

name: Overflow
text: Light healing beyond max HP becomes a Ward of Light: a shield up to 15% of max HP that lasts until hit or 2 cycles. Your Empowered allies get +25% instead of +15%.

name: Magnify
text: An ally (not you) standing on your light casts its first element or area skill each turn magnified, once per ally per turn: +1 radius on an AoE shape of radius 1-2 (never past 3), or else +1 charge step on its paint (the axis caps at 3).

name: Tidal Release
text: Action, cooldown 4: pick a pool hex within 3 and a heading. The pool drains, and a wave runs along the line (as long as the pool, max 6), pushing every unit on it 3 along it. The line gets water 2.

name: Riptide
text: At the start of your turn, every foe standing in water within 4 of you is pulled 1 toward you (counts against the wind field cap).

name: Wellspring
text: You and allies standing in your water heal 4% per level at the tick (4/8/12%). It doesn't stack with light healing on the same hex; the higher counts.

name: Conflagration
text: Your eruptions chain once: a ring hex your eruption raised to fire 3 erupts too (depth 2 at most). Each hex erupts once per action.

name: Trailblazer
text: Every hex you leave on a walk gets fire 1, up to 4 per turn. You take no crossing damage.

name: Phoenix Heart
text: Your own fire never damages you. Starting your turn on fire 3, you heal what it would have burned (12%). Once per battle, a KO blow on you while you stand on fire leaves you at 1 HP and Overheats your hex.

name: Contagion
text: When a foe with Rot is KO'd, its Rot jumps to every foe within 2 (+1 stack each, capped at 3).

name: Doom
text: A foe reaching 3 Rot is Doomed: at the end of its next turn it takes 15% max HP plus 5% per Rot, and 50% of that hits adjacent foes; then its Rot clears. Once per foe per battle.

name: Event Horizon
text: At the tick, foes within 2 of your dark 3 are pulled 1 toward it (counts against the wind field cap), and a foe standing on your dark 3 can't be healed.

name: Static Blades
text: Each basic hit you land arms your fuse on the target's hex (if it holds no charge). A backstab on a foe standing on your fuse detonates it: 12% to the occupant and 6% splash, plus your thunder bonus. One burst per turn, one Static Blade fuse per foe.

name: Blast Rider
text: You're immune to your own detonations. When a detonation you cause is on your own hex, it splashes as normal and you're launched: move 2 after the action (replaces Bolt Step's +2). Once per turn; you can't re-arm your own hex until your next turn.

name: Daisy Chain
text: Once per turn, when your fuse detonates, one other fuse of yours within 3 detonates in the same action (an empty fuse blows at the 5% base). Nothing chains further.
